theme.archetype: 5 (Jewel & Luxury / Cinematic Moody) - Adapted for Anime/Otaku aesthetic
theme.description: An immersive, cinematic dark theme that lets vibrant anime/manga cover art pop. Avoids typical generic purple/teal SaaS defaults in favor of a deep ink/void base with intense crimson and gold accents.

headings.usage: Used for page titles, anime titles, and major section headers. It provides a bold, dynamic feel similar to Shonen/Seinen manga titles.

body.usage: Highly legible for synopsis, chat messages, and reviews.

rules: DO NOT use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter on Arabic text as it breaks cursive connections.
Import fonts via Google Fonts: <link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cairo:wght@400;600;700&family=Kufam:wght@400;700;800&display=swap' rel='stylesheet'>
No generic Inter or Roboto fonts.

spacing_and_layout.rtl_protocol: CRITICAL: The entire application MUST use dir='rtl' on the <html> or root element. Use logical properties in Tailwind: `ps/pe` (padding-start/end) instead of `pl/pr`, and `ms/me` instead of `ml/mr`.

grid_patterns.catalog: Fluid masonry or dense grid (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6) for anime/manga covers. Gap-4 to Gap-6.
grid_patterns.profile: Bento Grid style. Asymmetric blocks for stats (Watched, Reading, Dropped) vs Recent Friends vs Bio.
grid_patterns.chat: Full height layout (h-screen) with fixed sidebar/bottom input, scrollable message area.

spacing_and_layout.containers: No borders on image-heavy cards. Use 1px border-border/40 on text-heavy or input containers.

catalog_card.style: Aspect ratio [2/3] for covers. Fully flush image. No padding around the image. Card radius rounded-lg.
catalog_card.overlay: Gradient overlay at the bottom `bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent` to ensure white Arabic title text is highly readable.
catalog_card.interaction: Hover state: -translate-y-2 scale-105 duration-300 with shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(230,57,70,0.2)] (Primary color glow).

chat_bubble.style: Glassmorphism for modern feel over dark backgrounds.
chat_bubble.sender: bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md text-text_primary rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm (RTL adjustment)
chat_bubble.current_user: bg-primary/20 backdrop-blur-md border border-primary/30 text-text_primary rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm (RTL adjustment)

buttons.style: Sharp edges or minimal radius (rounded-md). High contrast.

navigation.mobile: Sticky bottom navigation bar with crystal glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0F111A]/80 border-t border-border`).
navigation.desktop: Top or side navigation with heavy blur. Logo should stand out.

testing.requirements: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, cards) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case. e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`, `data-testid='chat-input-field'`, `data-testid='catalog-item-123'`.

hero_background.description: Tokyo night alley. Use as the main cinematic background for the lobby/login/hero area with a dark overlay.

micro_interactions.hover: Cards lift and cast a glowing drop-shadow. Navigation links get a 2px bottom underline slide animation.
micro_interactions.chat: New messages slide in from the bottom with a slight fade (Framer Motion: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}).
micro_interactions.tabs: Use an animated background pill for the active tab state.
